cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What do you gain if your cousin wins the club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And which of your proposals becomes easier to approve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I know which square of competence we're discussing.
